name: Plano Brasileiro de Inteligência Artificial (PBIA) 2024–2028: IA para o Bem de Todos
description: Plano Brasileiro de Inteligência Artificial (PBIA) 2024–2028: IA para o Bem de Todos (July 30, 2024). Brazil's national artificial intelligence strategies led by the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI), comprising the Estratégia Brasileira de Inteligência Artificial (EBIA, established by Portaria MCTI nº 4.617 of April 6, 2021) and the R$ 23 billion Plano Brasileiro de Inteligência Artificial (PBIA 2024–2028, 'IA para o Bem de Todos', launched July 30, 2024).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Governo Federal do Brasil (gov.br) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Governo Federal do Brasil (gov.br).
